Chapter 10. Real-time Gaming Leaderboard

第 10 章 实时游戏排行榜
逐段中英对照 · 点击英文段显示/隐藏译文 · 右下角 🌐 切换语言模式
§Chapter 10. Real-time Gaming Leaderboard第 10 章 实时游戏排行榜

In this chapter, we are going to walk through the challenge of designing a leaderboard for an online mobile game.

在本章中，我们将一步步面对为一款在线手机游戏设计排行榜的挑战。

What is a leaderboard? Leaderboards are common in gaming and elsewhere to show who is leading a particular tournament or competition. Users are assigned points for completing tasks or challenges, and whoever has the most points is at the top of the leaderboard. Figure 1 shows an example of a mobile game leaderboard. The leaderboard shows the ranking of the leading competitors and also displays the position of the user on it.

什么是排行榜？排行榜在游戏及其他领域很常见，用来展示谁在某项锦标赛或竞赛中领先。用户完成任务或挑战会获得积分，积分最高者排在榜首。图 1 是一个手机游戏排行榜示例。排行榜既展示领先玩家的排名，也显示当前用户在其中的位置。

§Step 1 - Understand the Problem and Establish Design Scope第一步——理解问题并确定设计范围

Leaderboards can be pretty straightforward, but there are a number of different matters that can add complexity. As the candidate, you should clarify the requirements.

排行榜看起来相当简单，但有不少细节会增加复杂度。作为候选人，你应当澄清需求。

Candidate: How is the score calculated for the leaderboard?

候选人：排行榜的分数如何计算？

Interviewer: The user gets a point when they win a match. We can go with a simple point system in which each user has a score associated with them. Each time the user wins a match, we should add a point to their total score.

面试官：用户赢得一局比赛得 1 分。我们可以采用简单的积分制，每个用户都关联一个分数。用户每赢一局，就给总分加 1 分。

Candidate: Are all players included in the leaderboard?

候选人：所有玩家都进入排行榜吗？

Interviewer: Yes.

面试官：是的。

Candidate: Is there a time segment associated with the leaderboard?

候选人：排行榜是否与某个时间段关联？

Interviewer: Each month, a new tournament kicks off which starts a new leaderboard.

面试官：每个月开启新的锦标赛，同时开启新的排行榜。

Candidate: Can we assume we only care about the top 10 users?

候选人：我们可以假设只关心前 10 名用户吗？

Interviewer: We want to display the top 10 users as well as the position of a specific user on the leaderboard. If time allows, let’s also discuss how to return players who are four places above and below a specific user.

面试官：我们要展示前 10 名用户，以及某个特定用户在排行榜上的位置。如果时间允许，再讨论如何返回排在该用户前后各 4 名的玩家。

Candidate: How many users are in a tournament?

候选人：一场锦标赛有多少用户？

Interviewer: Average of 5 million daily active users (DAU) and 25 million monthly active users (MAU).

面试官：平均 500 万日活跃用户（DAU）、2500 万月活跃用户（MAU）。

Candidate: How many matches are played on average during a tournament?

候选人：一场锦标赛平均进行多少局比赛？

Interviewer: Each player plays 10 matches per day on average.

面试官：每个玩家平均每天进行 10 局比赛。

Candidate: How do you determine the rank if two players have the same score?

候选人：如果两个玩家分数相同，如何确定排名？

Interviewer: In this case, their ranks are the same. If time allows, you can talk about ways to break ties.

面试官：这种情况下他们排名相同。如果时间允许，可以谈谈如何打破平局。

Candidate: Does the leaderboard need to be real-time?

候选人：排行榜需要实时吗？

Interviewer: Yes, we want to present real-time results, or as close as possible. It is not okay to present a batched history of results.

面试官：是的，我们要呈现实时结果，或尽可能接近实时。不可以呈现批量的历史结果。

Now that we’ve gathered all the requirements, let’s list the functional requirements.

收集完所有需求后，我们列出功能需求。

  • Display top 10 players on the leaderboard.

    展示排行榜前 10 名玩家。

  • Show a user’s specific rank.

    展示某个用户的具体排名。

  • Display players who are four places above and below the desired user (bonus).

    展示目标用户前后各 4 名的玩家（加分项）。

Other than clarifying functional requirements, it’s important to understand non-functional requirements.

除澄清功能需求外，理解非功能需求也很重要。

Non-functional requirements

非功能需求

  • Real-time update on scores.

    分数实时更新。

  • Score update is reflected on the leaderboard in real-time.

    分数更新实时反映在排行榜上。

  • General scalability, availability, and reliability requirements.

    一般的可扩展性、可用性和可靠性要求。

§Back-of-the-envelope estimation粗略估算

Let’s take a look at some back-of-the-envelope calculations to determine the potential scale and challenges our solution will need to address. You want to discuss how many queries per second we may need to account for when creating the design, as well as the size of storage needs.

让我们做一些粗略估算，确定解决方案需要应对的潜在规模和挑战。在设计时，你要讨论每秒需要考虑多少查询，以及存储需求有多大。

With 5 million DAU, if the game had an even distribution of players during a 24-hour period, we would have an average of 50 users per second (5,000,000 DAU / 10^5 seconds = ~50). However, we know that usages most likely aren’t evenly distributed, and potentially there are peaks during evenings when many people across different time zones have time to play. To account for this, we could assume that peak load would be 5 times the average. Therefore we’d want to allow for a peak load of 250 users per second.

有 500 万 DAU，如果玩家在 24 小时内均匀分布，则平均每秒 50 个用户（5,000,000 DAU / 10^5 秒 ≈ 50）。然而我们知道使用量很可能并不均匀，晚间跨时区的人们有时间玩游戏时可能出现峰值。为此可以假设峰值负载是平均的 5 倍，因此要预留每秒 250 个用户的峰值负载。

QPS for users scoring a point: if a user plays 10 games per day on average, the QPS for users scoring a point is: 50 x 10 = ~500. Peak QPS is 5x of the average: 500 x 5 = 2,500.

得分 QPS：如果用户平均每天玩 10 局，则用户得分的 QPS 为 50 × 10 ≈ 500。峰值 QPS 是平均的 5 倍：500 × 5 = 2,500。

QPS for fetching the top 10 leaderboard: assume a user opens the game once a day and the top 10 leaderboard is loaded only when a user first opens the game. The QPS for this is around 50.

拉取前 10 排行榜的 QPS：假设用户每天打开游戏一次，且只在首次打开时加载前 10 排行榜，此 QPS 约为 50。

§Step 2 - Propose High-Level Design and Get Buy-In第二步——提出高层设计并获得认可

In this section, we will discuss API design, high-level architecture, and two potential solutions for data models: relational database-based and Redis-based solutions.

本节讨论 API 设计、高层架构，以及数据模型的两种潜在方案：基于关系型数据库和基于 Redis 的方案。

在高层上，我们需要以下三个 API：

§High-level architecture高层架构

The high-level design diagram is shown in Figure 2. There are two services in this design. The game service allows users to play the game and the leaderboard service creates and displays a leaderboard.

高层设计图如图 2 所示。本设计有两个服务：游戏服务让用户玩游戏，排行榜服务创建并展示排行榜。

  1. When a player wins a game, the client sends a request to the game service.

    玩家赢得一局时，客户端向游戏服务发送请求。

  2. The game service ensures the win is valid and calls the leaderboard service to update the score.

    游戏服务确认胜利有效，并调用排行榜服务更新分数。

  3. The leaderboard service updates the user’s score on the leaderboard store.

    排行榜服务在排行榜存储中更新该用户的分数。

  4. A player makes a call to the leaderboard service directly to fetch leaderboard data, including:

    玩家直接调用排行榜服务拉取排行榜数据，包括：

  1. top 10 leaderboard.

    前 10 排行榜。

  2. the rank of the player on the leaderboard.

    该玩家在排行榜上的排名。

Before settling on this design, we considered a few alternatives and decided against them. It might be helpful to go through the thought process of this and to compare different options.

在敲定这个设计之前，我们考虑过几种替代方案并最终放弃。梳理这个思考过程、对比不同方案会很有帮助。

Should the client talk to the leaderboard service directly?

客户端应该直接与排行榜服务通信吗？

In the alternative design, the score is set by the client. This option is not secure because it is subject to man-in-the-middle attack [1], where players can put in a proxy and change scores at will. Therefore, we need the score to be set on the server-side.

在替代设计中，分数由客户端设置。这种方式不安全，因为它容易遭受中间人攻击 [1]：玩家可以挂一个代理，随意篡改分数。因此我们必须在服务端设置分数。

Note that for server authoritative games such as online poker, the client may not need to call the game server explicitly to set scores. The game server handles all game logic, and it knows when the game finishes and could set the score without any client intervention.

请注意，对于线上扑克等服务端权威型游戏，客户端可能无需显式调用游戏服务器来设置分数。游戏服务器处理所有游戏逻辑，它知道何时结束，可以在无客户端介入的情况下设置分数。

Do we need a message queue between the game service and the leaderboard service?

游戏服务与排行榜服务之间需要消息队列吗？

The answer to this question highly depends on how the game scores are used. If the data is used in other places or supports multiple functionalities, then it might make sense to put data in Kafka as shown in Figure 4. This way, the same data can be consumed by multiple consumers, such as leaderboard service, analytics service, push notification service, etc. This is especially true when the game is a turn-based or multi-player game in which we need to notify other players about the score update. As this is not an explicit requirement based on the conversation with the interviewer, we do not use a message queue in our design.

这个问题的答案高度依赖游戏分数如何被使用。如果数据还在别处使用或支撑多个功能，那么如图 4 所示把数据放进 Kafka 可能是合理的。这样，同一份数据可被多个消费者消费，如排行榜服务、分析服务、推送通知服务等。当游戏是回合制或多人游戏、需要把分数更新通知其他玩家时，尤其如此。由于根据与面试官的对话这并非明确需求，我们的设计中不使用消息队列。

§Data models数据模型

One of the key components in the system is the leaderboard store. We will discuss three potential solutions: relational database, Redis, and NoSQL (NoSQL solution is explained in deep dive).

系统的关键组件之一是排行榜存储。我们将讨论三种潜在方案：关系型数据库、Redis 和 NoSQL（NoSQL 方案在深入设计中讲解）。

§Relational database solution关系型数据库方案

First, let’s take a step back and start with the simplest solution. What if the scale doesn’t matter and you have only a few users?

首先，让我们退一步，从最简单的方案开始。如果规模不重要、你只有很少用户呢？

You would most likely opt to have a simple leaderboard solution using a relational database system (RDS). Each monthly leaderboard could be represented as a database table containing user id and score columns. When the user wins a match, either award the user 1 point if they are new, or increase their existing score by 1 point. To determine a user’s ranking on the leaderboard, you would sort the table by the score in descending order. The details are explained below.

你很可能会选择用关系型数据库系统（RDS）实现一个简单的排行榜方案。每个月的排行榜可以表示为一张数据库表，包含 user_id 和 score 两列。用户赢一局时，若是新用户就给 1 分，否则在现有分数上加 1。要确定用户在排行榜上的名次，就按 score 降序排序这张表。细节如下。

Leaderboard DB table:

排行榜数据库表：

In reality, the leaderboard table has additional information, such as a game_id, a timestamp, etc. However, the underlying logic of how to query and update the leaderboard remains the same. For simplicity, we assume only the current month’s leaderboard data is stored in the leaderboard table.

实际中，排行榜表还有 game_id、时间戳等附加信息。但查询和更新排行榜的底层逻辑不变。为简单起见，我们假设排行榜表中只存当月数据。

A user wins a point:

用户赢得 1 分：

Assume every score update would be an increment of 1. If a user doesn’t yet have an entry in the leaderboard for the month, the first insert would be:

假设每次分数更新都是加 1。如果用户在当月排行榜中还没有记录，第一次插入为：

INSERT INTO leaderboard (user_id, score) VALUES ( 'mary1934', 1 );

An update to the user’s score would be:

对用户分数的更新为：

UPDATE leaderboard SET score = score + 1 WHERE user_id = 'mary1934';

Find a user’s leaderboard position:

查找用户在排行榜中的位置：

To fetch the user rank, you would sort the leaderboard table and rank by the score:

要获取用户排名，对排行榜表排序并按分数排名：

SELECT ( @rownum := @rownum + 1 ) AS rank, user_id, score FROM leaderboard ORDER BY score DESC;

The result of the SQL query looks like this:

SQL 查询结果如下：

rank

排名

user_id

用户 ID

score

分数

1

happy_tomato

987

2

mallow

902

3

smith

870

4

mary1934

850
Table 4 Result sorted by score表 4 按分数排序的结果

This solution works when the data set is small, but the query becomes very slow when there are millions of rows. Let’s take a look at why.

数据集小时该方案可行，但行数达到数百万时查询会变得非常慢。我们看看原因。

To figure out the rank of a user, we need to sort every single player into their correct spot on the leaderboard so we can determine exactly what the correct rank is. Remember that there can be duplicate scores as well, so the rank isn’t just the position of the user in the list.

要算出某用户的排名，我们需要把每个玩家都排到排行榜上正确位置，才能精确确定名次。请记住，分数可能重复，所以排名不只是用户在列表中的位置。

SQL databases are not performant when we have to process large amounts of continuously changing information. Attempting to do a rank operation over millions of rows is going to take 10s of seconds, which is not acceptable for the desired real-time approach. Since the data is constantly changing, it is also not feasible to consider a cache.

当我们必须处理大量持续变化的信息时，SQL 数据库性能不佳。对数百万行做排名操作会耗时数十秒，这对所需的实时方案不可接受。由于数据持续变化，考虑缓存也不可行。

A relational database is not designed to handle the high load of read queries this implementation would require. An RDS could be used successfully if done as a batch operation, but that would not align with the requirement to return a real-time position for the user on the leaderboard.

关系型数据库并非为应对本实现所需的高读查询负载而设计。如果作为批量操作，RDS 可以用，但那与“实时返回用户在排行榜上位置”的需求不符。

One optimization we can do is to add an index and limit the number of pages to scan with the LIMIT clause. The query looks like this:

我们可以做的一个优化是加索引，并用 LIMIT 子句限制扫描页数。查询如下：

SELECT ( @rownum := @rownum + 1 ) AS rank, user_id, score FROM leaderboard ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10;

However, this approach doesn’t scale well. First, finding a user's rank is not performant because it essentially requires a table scan to determine the rank. Second, this approach doesn’t provide a straightforward solution for determining the rank of a user who is not at the top of the leaderboard.

然而这种方案扩展性不好。第一，查找用户排名性能不佳，因为它本质上需要全表扫描来确定排名。第二，对于不在排行榜顶部的用户，这种方案无法直接给出其排名。

§Redis solutionRedis 方案

We want to find a solution that gives us predictable performance even for millions of users and allows us to have easy access to common leaderboard operations, without needing to fall back on complex DB queries.

我们想要一个即使面对数百万用户也能提供可预测性能的方案，让我们轻松完成常见排行榜操作，而不必退回复杂的数据库查询。

Redis provides a potential solution to our problem. Redis is an in-memory data store supporting key-value pairs. Since it works in memory, it allows for fast reads and writes. Redis has a specific data type called sorted sets that are ideal for solving leaderboard system design problems.

Redis 为我们的问题提供了一种潜在方案。Redis 是支持键值对的内存数据存储。由于工作在内存中，它读写很快。Redis 有一种名为有序集合（sorted set）的特定数据类型，非常适合解决排行榜系统设计问题。

§What are sorted sets?什么是有序集合？

A sorted set is a data type similar to a set. Each member of a sorted set is associated with a score. The members of a set must be unique, but scores may repeat. The score is used to rank the sorted set in ascending order.

有序集合是一种类似集合的数据类型。有序集合的每个成员都关联一个分数。集合成员必须唯一，但分数可以重复。分数用于将有序集合按升序排列。

Our leaderboard use case maps perfectly to sorted sets. Internally, a sorted set is implemented by two data structures: a hash table and a skip list [2]. The hash table maps users to scores and the skip list maps scores to users. In sorted sets, users are sorted by scores. A good way to understand a sorted set is to picture it as a table with score and member columns as shown in Figure 8. The table is sorted by score in descending order.

我们的排行榜用例与有序集合完美对应。在内部，有序集合由两种数据结构实现：哈希表和跳表 [2]。哈希表把用户映射到分数，跳表把分数映射到用户。在有序集合中，用户按分数排序。理解有序集合的一个好办法是把它想象成一张有 score 和 member 两列的表，如图 8，该表按 score 降序排列。

In this chapter, we don’t go into the full detail of the sorted set implementation, but we do go over the high-level ideas.

本章不深入有序集合实现的全部细节，但会讲其高层思想。

A skip list is a list structure that allows for fast search. It consists of a base sorted linked list and multi-level indexes. Let’s take a look at an example. In Figure 9, the base list is a sorted singly-linked list. The time complexity of insertion, removal, and search operations is O(n).

跳表（skip list）是一种支持快速查找的列表结构。它由一个底层有序链表和多级索引组成。看一个例子：在图 9 中，底层链表是一个有序单链表，插入、删除和查找操作的时间复杂度为 O(n)。

How can we make those operations faster? One idea is to get to the middle quickly, as the binary search algorithm does. To achieve that, we add a level 1 index that skips every other node, and then a level 2 index that skips every other node of the level 1 indexes. Repeat this logic until we have level x indexes that jump approximately to the middle. As you can see in Figure 9, to search for number 45 is a lot faster when we have multi-level indexes.

如何让这些操作更快？一个思路是像二分查找那样快速到达中间。为此，我们加一个每隔一个节点跳跃的 1 级索引，再加一个在 1 级索引上每隔一个节点跳跃的 2 级索引。重复此逻辑，直到有一个大约跳到中间的 x 级索引。如图 9 所示，有了多级索引，查找数字 45 快得多。

When the data set is small, the speed improvement using the skip list isn’t obvious. Figure 10 shows an example of a skip list with 5 levels of indexes. In the base linked list, it needs to travel 62 nodes to reach the correct node. In the skip list, it only needs to traverse 11 nodes [3].

数据集小时，跳表带来的提速并不明显。图 10 是一个有 5 级索引的跳表示例。在底层链表中要走 62 个节点才能到达正确节点；在跳表中只需遍历 11 个节点 [3]。

Sorted sets are more performant than a relational database because each element is automatically positioned in the right order during insert or update, as well as the fact that the complexity of an add or find operation in a sorted set is logarithmic: O(log n).

有序集合比关系型数据库性能更好，因为每个元素在插入或更新时会自动被放到正确位置；而且有序集合中添加或查找操作的复杂度是对数级的：O(log n)。

In contrast, to calculate the rank of a specific user in a relational database, we need to run nested queries:

相比之下，要在关系型数据库中计算某个用户的排名，我们需要运行嵌套查询：

SELECT *, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaderboard lb2 WHERE lb2.score >= lb1.score ) RANK FROM leaderboard lb1 WHERE lb1.user_id = {:user_id};
§Implementation using Redis sorted sets用 Redis 有序集合实现

Now that we know sorted sets are fast, let’s take a look at the Redis operations we will use to build our leaderboard [4] [5] [6] [7]:

既然知道有序集合很快，我们来看看构建排行榜要用到哪些 Redis 操作 [4][5][6][7]：

  • ZADD: insert the user into the set if they don’t yet exist. Otherwise, update the score for the user. It takes O(log(n)) to execute.

    ZADD：如果用户尚不存在就插入集合，否则更新该用户的分数。执行耗时 O(log(n))。

  • ZINCRBY: increment the score of the user by the specified increment. If the user doesn’t exist in the set, then it assumes the score starts at 0. It takes O(log(n)) to execute.

    ZINCRBY：把用户分数增加指定增量。如果用户不在集合中，则假定分数从 0 开始。执行耗时 O(log(n))。

  • ZRANGE/ZREVRANGE: fetch a range of users sorted by the score. You can specify the order (range vs. revrange), the number of entries, and the position to start from. This takes O(log(n)+m) to execute, where m is the number of entries to fetch (which is usually small in our case), and n is the number of entries in the sorted set.

    ZRANGE/ZREVRANGE：拉取一段按分数排序的用户。可以指定顺序（range 与 revrange）、条目数和起始位置。执行耗时 O(log(n)+m)，其中 m 是要取的条目数（我们这里通常很小），n 是有序集合中的条目数。

  • ZRANK/ZREVRANK: Fetch the position of any user sorting in ascending/descending order in logarithmic time.

    ZRANK/ZREVRANK：在对数时间内，按升序/降序获取任一用户的位置。

Workflow with sorted sets

有序集合的工作流

1. A user scores a point

1. 用户赢得 1 分

Every month we create a new leaderboard sorted set and the previous ones are moved to historical data storage. When a user wins a match, they score 1 point; so we call ZINCRBY to increment the user’s score by 1 in that month’s leaderboard, or add the user to the leaderboard set if they weren’t already there. The syntax for ZINCRBY is:

每个月我们创建一个新的排行榜有序集合，之前的集合转入历史数据存储。用户赢一局得 1 分，因此我们调用 ZINCRBY 在当月排行榜中把该用户分数加 1，若用户不在排行榜集合中则加入。ZINCRBY 语法为：

ZINCRBY

The following command adds a point to user ‘mary1934’ after they win a match.

以下命令在用户 “mary1934” 赢一局后给其加 1 分。

ZINCRBY leaderboard_feb_2021 1 'mary1934'

2. A user fetches the top 10 global leaderboard

2. 用户拉取全球前 10 排行榜

We will call ZREVRANGE to obtain the members in descending order because we want the highest scores, and pass the ‘WITHSCORES’ attribute to ensure that it also returns the total score for each user, as well as the set of users with the highest scores. The following command fetches the top 10 players on the Feb-2021 leaderboard.

我们调用 ZREVRANGE 以降序获取成员，因为我们要最高分；并传入 “WITHSCORES” 属性，确保它同时返回每个用户的总分以及最高分用户集合。以下命令拉取 2021 年 2 月排行榜的前 10 名玩家。

ZREVRANGE leaderboard_feb_2021 0 9 WITHSCORES

This returns a list like this:

它返回这样一个列表：

[(user2, score2), (user1, score1), (user5, score5), ...]

3. A user wants to fetch their leaderboard position

3. 用户想拉取自己的排行榜位置

To fetch the position of a user in the leaderboard, we will call ZREVRANK to retrieve their rank on the leaderboard. Again, we call the rev version of the command because we want to rank scores from high to low.

要拉取用户在排行榜中的位置，我们调用 ZREVRANK 取得其排名。同样，我们调用 rev 版本命令，因为要按分数从高到低排名。

ZREVRANK leaderboard_feb_2021 'mary1934'

4. Fetch the relative position in the leaderboard for a user. An example is shown in Figure 14.

4. 拉取某用户在排行榜中的相对位置。例如见图 14。

While not an explicit requirement, you can easily fetch the relative position for a user by leveraging ZREVRANGE with the number of results above and below the desired player. For example, if user Mallow007’s rank is 361 and we want to fetch 4 players above and below them, we would run the following command.

虽然这不是明确需求，但你可以利用 ZREVRANGE、指定目标玩家上下要取的结果数，轻松拉取其相对位置。例如，用户 Mallow007 排名 361，我们想取其前后各 4 名，就运行以下命令。

ZREVRANGE leaderboard_feb_2021 357 365
§Storage requirement存储需求

At a minimum, we need to store the user id and score. The worst-case scenario is that all 25 million monthly active users have won at least one game, and they all have entries in the leaderboard for the month. Assuming the id is a 24-character string and the score is a 16-bit integer (or 2 bytes), we need 26 bytes of storage per leaderboard entry. Given the worst-case scenario of one leaderboard entry per MAU, we would need 26 bytes x 25 million = 650 million bytes or ~650 MB for leaderboard storage in the in-memory Redis cache. Even if we double the memory usage to account for the overhead of the skip list and the hash for the sorted set, one modern Redis server is more than enough to hold the data.

至少，我们需要存用户 id 和分数。最坏情况是全部 2500 万月活跃用户都至少赢过一局，且都在当月排行榜中有记录。假设 id 是 24 字符的字符串、分数是 16 位整数（即 2 字节），则每条排行榜记录需要 26 字节存储。按每个 MAU 一条排行榜记录的最坏情况，内存 Redis 缓存中存储排行榜需要 26 字节 × 2500 万 = 6.5 亿字节，即约 650MB。即使把内存占用翻倍以计入跳表和有序集合哈希的开销，一台现代 Redis 服务器也绰绰有余。

Another related factor to consider is CPU and I/O usage. Our peak QPS from the back-of-the-envelope estimation is 2500 updates/sec. This is well within the performance envelope of a single Redis server.

另一个相关因素是 CPU 和 I/O 使用。粗略估算的峰值 QPS 是每秒 2500 次更新，远在单台 Redis 服务器的性能范围之内。

One concern about the Redis cache is persistence, as a Redis node might fail. Luckily, Redis does support persistence, but restarting a large Redis instance from disk is slow. Usually, Redis is configured with a read replica, and when the main instance fails, the read replica is promoted, and a new read replica is attached.

对 Redis 缓存的一个担忧是持久化，因为 Redis 节点可能故障。幸运的是 Redis 确实支持持久化，但从磁盘重启一个大型 Redis 实例很慢。通常 Redis 配置一个只读副本，主实例故障时提升只读副本为主，并再挂一个新的只读副本。

Besides, we need to have 2 supporting tables (user and point) in MySQL persistent relational database storage. The user table would store the user ID and user’s display name (in a real-world application, this would contain a lot more data). The point table would contain the user id, score, and timestamp when they won a game. This can be leveraged for other game functions such as play history, and can also be used to recreate the Redis leaderboard in the event of an infrastructure failure.

此外，我们需要在 MySQL 持久化关系数据库存储中有两张辅助表（user 和 point）。user 表存用户 ID 和用户显示名（真实应用中还会有更多数据）。point 表存用户 id、分数以及赢一局的时间戳。这可用于对局历史等其他游戏功能，也可在基础设施故障时重建 Redis 排行榜。

As a small performance optimization, it may make sense to create an additional cache of the user details, potentially for the top 10 players since they are retrieved most frequently. However, this doesn’t amount to a large amount of data.

作为一个小的性能优化，可以再建一个用户详情缓存，或许就缓存前 10 名玩家，因为他们被最频繁地读取。不过这数据量并不大。

§Step 3 - Design Deep Dive第三步——深入设计

Now that we’ve discussed the high-level design, let’s dive into the following:

讨论完高层设计后，我们深入以下内容：

  • Whether or not to use a cloud provider: manage our own services; leverage cloud service providers like Amazon Web Services (AWS).

    是否使用云服务商：自建服务；或利用 Amazon Web Services（AWS）等云服务商。

  • Scaling Redis

    扩展 Redis

  • Alternative solution: NoSQL

    替代方案：NoSQL

  • Other considerations

    其他考量

§To use a cloud provider or not是否使用云服务商

Depending on the existing infrastructure, we generally have two options for deploying our solution. Let’s take a look at each of them.

根据现有基础设施，部署我们的方案通常有两种选择。我们逐一来看。

§Manage our own services自建服务

In this approach, we will create a leaderboard sorted set each month to store the leaderboard data for that period. The sorted set stores member and score information. The rest of the details about the user, such as their name and profile image, are stored in MySQL databases. When fetching the leaderboard, besides the leaderboard data, API servers also query the database to fetch corresponding users’ names and profile images to display on the leaderboard. If this becomes too inefficient in the long term, we can leverage a user profile cache to store users’ details for the top 10 players. The design is shown in Figure 15.

这种方案下，我们每月创建一个排行榜有序集合来存储该月排行榜数据。有序集合存成员和分数信息。用户的其余详情（如姓名、头像）存在 MySQL 数据库中。拉取排行榜时，除排行榜数据外，API 服务器还查询数据库取出对应用户的姓名和头像以展示在排行榜上。如果长期看这变得低效，可以利用用户资料缓存来存前 10 名玩家的详情。设计如图 15。

§Build on the cloud基于云构建

The second approach is to leverage cloud infrastructures. In this section, we assume our existing infrastructure is built on AWS and that it’s a natural fit to build the leaderboard on the cloud. We will use two major AWS technologies in this design: Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda function [8]. The Amazon API gateway provides a way to define the HTTP endpoints of a RESTful API and connect it to any backend services. We use it to connect to our AWS lambda functions. The mapping between Restful APIs and lambda functions is shown in Table 5.

第二种方案是利用云基础设施。本节假设现有基础设施构建在 AWS 上，那么在云上构建排行榜顺理成章。本设计用到两项主要 AWS 技术：Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数 [8]。Amazon API Gateway 提供定义 RESTful API 的 HTTP 端点并将其连接到任意后端服务的方式。我们用它连接 AWS Lambda 函数。RESTful API 与 Lambda 函数的映射如表 5。

APIs

API

Lambda function

Lambda 函数

GET /v1/scores/{:user_id}

LeaderboardFetchTop10

GET /v1/scores

LeaderboardFetchPlayerRank

POST /v1/scores

LeaderboardUpdateScore
Table 5 Lambda functions表 5 Lambda 函数

AWS Lambda is one of the most popular serverless computing platforms. It allows you to run code without having to provision or manage the servers yourself. It runs only when needed and will scale automatically based on traffic. Serverless is one of the hottest topics in cloud services and is supported by all major cloud service providers. For example, Google Cloud has Google Cloud Functions [9] and Microsoft has named its offering Microsoft Azure Functions [10].

AWS Lambda 是最流行的无服务器计算平台之一。它让你无需自己开通或管理服务器就能运行代码。它只在需要时运行，并根据流量自动扩展。无服务器是云服务中最热门的话题之一，所有主流云服务商都支持。例如，Google Cloud 有 Google Cloud Functions [9]，Microsoft 的产品名为 Microsoft Azure Functions [10]。

At a high level, our game calls the Amazon API Gateway, which in turn invokes the appropriate lambda functions. We will use AWS Lambda functions to invoke the appropriate commands on the storage layer (both Redis and MySQL), return the results back up to the API Gateway, and then to the application.

在高层上，我们的游戏调用 Amazon API Gateway，后者再调用相应的 Lambda 函数。我们用 AWS Lambda 函数在存储层（Redis 和 MySQL）上执行相应命令，把结果逐层返回 API Gateway，再返回应用。

We can leverage Lambda functions to perform the queries we need without having to spin up a server instance. AWS provides support for Redis clients that can be called from the Lambda functions. This also allows for auto-scaling as needed with DAU growth. Design diagrams for a user scoring a point and retrieving the leaderboard are shown below:

我们可以利用 Lambda 函数执行所需查询，而无需启动服务器实例。AWS 提供可从 Lambda 函数调用的 Redis 客户端支持。这也让我们能随 DAU 增长按需自动扩展。用户得分和取回排行榜的设计图如下：

Use case 1: scoring a point

用例 1：赢得 1 分

Use Case 2: retrieving leaderboard

用例 2：取回排行榜

Conclusion

结论

Lambdas are great because they are a serverless approach, and the infrastructure will take care of auto-scaling the function as needed. This means we don’t need to manage the scaling and environment setup and maintenance. Given this, we recommend going with a serverless approach if we build the game from the ground up.

Lambda 很棒，因为它是无服务器方案，基础设施会按需自动扩展函数。这意味着我们无需管理扩展、环境搭建和维护。鉴于此，如果从零构建游戏，我们建议采用无服务器方案。

§Scaling Redis扩展 Redis

With 5 million DAU, we can get away with one Redis cache from both a storage and QPS perspective. However, let’s imagine we have 500 million DAU, which is 100 times our original scale. Now our worst-case scenario for the size of the leaderboard goes up to 65 GB (650 MB x 100), and our QPS goes up to 250,000 (2,500 x 100) queries per second. This calls for a sharding solution.

有 500 万 DAU 时，从存储和 QPS 看，一台 Redis 缓存就够了。但想象我们有 5 亿 DAU，是原规模的 100 倍。此时排行榜最坏情况大小增至 65GB（650MB × 100），QPS 增至每秒 25 万（2,500 × 100）次查询。这就需要分片方案。

§Data sharding数据分片

We consider sharding in one of the following two ways: fixed or hash partitions.

我们考虑以下两种分片方式之一：固定分区或哈希分区。

Fixed partition

固定分区

One way to understand fixed partitions is to look at the overall range of points on the leaderboard. Let’s say that the number of points won in one month ranges from 1 to 1000, and we break up the data by range. For example, we could have 10 shards and each shard would have a range of 100 scores (ex. 1-100, 101-200, 201-300, etc.) as shown in Figure 18.

理解固定分区的一种方式是看排行榜上分数的整体区间。假设一个月内赢得的分数范围是 1 到 1000，我们按区间切分数据。例如，可以有 10 个分片，每个分片覆盖 100 分的区间（如 1-100、101-200、201-300 等），如图 18。

For this to work, we want to ensure there is an even distribution of scores across the leaderboard. Otherwise, we need to adjust the score range in each shard to make sure of a relatively even distribution. In this approach, we shard the data ourselves in the application code.

要让它工作，我们要确保分数在排行榜上均匀分布。否则需要调整每个分片的分数区间，以确保分布相对均匀。这种方案下，我们在应用代码中自己做分片。

When we are inserting or updating the score for a user, we need to know which shard they are in. We could do this by calculating the user’s current score from the MySQL database. This can work, but another more performant option is to create a secondary cache to store the mapping from user ID to score. We need to be careful when a user increases their score and moves between shards. In this case, we need to remove the user from their current shard and update the secondary cache.

插入或更新用户分数时，我们需要知道他在哪个分片。可以从 MySQL 数据库算出用户当前分数。这可行，但另一种更高性能的选择是建一个二级缓存，存用户 ID 到分数的映射。当用户加分并跨分片移动时要小心：此时需要把用户从当前分片移除，并更新二级缓存。

To fetch the top 10 players in the leaderboard, we would fetch the top 10 players from the shard (sorted set) with the highest scores. In Figure 18, the last shard with scores [901, 1000] contains the top 10 players.

要拉取排行榜前 10 名，我们从分数最高的那个分片（有序集合）中取前 10。在图 18 中，分数区间为 [901, 1000] 的最后一个分片包含前 10 名玩家。

To fetch the rank of a user, we would need to calculate the rank within their current shard (local rank), as well as the total number of players with higher scores in all of the shards. Note that the total number of players in a shard can be retrieved by running the “info keyspace” command in O(1) [11].

要拉取某用户排名，我们需要计算他在当前分片内的排名（本地排名），以及所有分片中分数更高的玩家总数。注意，一个分片内的玩家总数可以通过运行 “info keyspace” 命令在 O(1) 内取得 [11]。

§Hash partition哈希分区

A second approach is to use the Redis cluster, which is desirable if the scores are very clustered or clumped. Redis cluster provides a way to shard data automatically across multiple Redis nodes. It doesn’t use consistent hashing but a different form of sharding, where every key is part of a hash slot. There are 16384 hash slots [12] and we can compute the hash slot of a given key by doing CRC16(key) % 16384 [13]. This allows us to add and remove nodes in the cluster easily without redistributing all the keys. In Figure 19, we have 3 nodes, where:

第二种方案是使用 Redis Cluster，当分数非常聚集或扎堆时它很合适。Redis Cluster 提供一种在多个 Redis 节点间自动分片数据的方式。它不使用一致性哈希，而是另一种分片形式：每个键都属于某个哈希槽。共有 16384 个哈希槽 [12]，给定键的哈希槽可由 CRC16(key) % 16384 [13] 算出。这让我们能轻松在集群中增加和移除节点，而无需重新分布所有键。在图 19 中，我们有 3 个节点：

  • The first node contains hash slots [0, 5500].

    第一个节点包含哈希槽 [0, 5500]。

  • The second node contains hash slots [5501, 11000].

    第二个节点包含哈希槽 [5501, 11000]。

  • The third node contains hash slots [11001, 16383].

    第三个节点包含哈希槽 [11001, 16383]。

An update would simply change the score of the user in the corresponding shard (determined by CRC16(key) %16384). Retrieving the top 10 players on the leaderboard is more complicated. We need to gather the top 10 players from each shard and have the application sort the data. A concrete example is shown in Figure 20. Those queries can be parallelized to reduce latency.

更新只需在对应分片（由 CRC16(key) %16384 确定）中修改该用户分数。取回排行榜前 10 名则更复杂：我们需要从每个分片收集前 10 名，再由应用对数据排序。具体例子见图 20。这些查询可以并行执行以降低延迟。

This approach has a few limitations:

这种方案有几个局限：

  • When we need to return top K results (where K is a very large number) on the leaderboard, the latency is high because a lot of entries are returned from each shard and need to be sorted.

    当需要在排行榜上返回前 K 个结果（K 很大）时，延迟较高，因为每个分片都要返回大量条目并排序。

  • Latency is high if we have lots of partitions because the query has to wait for the slowest partition.

    如果分区很多，延迟会高，因为查询必须等待最慢的分区。

  • Another issue with this approach is that it doesn’t provide a straightforward solution for determining the rank of a specific user.

    这种方案的另一个问题是：它无法直接确定某个特定用户的排名。

Therefore, we lean towards the first proposal: fixed partition.

因此我们倾向于第一个方案：固定分区。

§Sizing a Redis nodeRedis 节点容量规划

There are multiple things to consider when sizing your Redis nodes [14]. Write-heavy applications require much more available memory, since we need to be able to accommodate all of the writes to create the snapshot in case of a failure. To be safe, allocate twice the amount of memory for write-heavy applications.

规划 Redis 节点容量时要考虑多个因素 [14]。写密集型应用需要多得多的可用内存，因为我们必须能容纳所有写入，以便在故障时创建快照。为保险起见，写密集型应用分配两倍内存。

Redis provides a tool called Redis-benchmark that allows you to benchmark the performance of your Redis setup, by simulating multiple clients executing multiple queries and returning the number of requests per second for the given hardware. To learn more about Redis-benchmark, see [15].

Redis 提供一个叫 Redis-benchmark 的工具，可以模拟多个客户端执行多个查询、返回给定硬件下每秒请求数，从而对 Redis 部署做性能基准测试。想了解更多，见 [15]。

§Alternative solution: NoSQL替代方案：NoSQL

An alternative solution to consider is NoSQL databases. If you are not familiar with Redis, this can be a good option to talk about during the interview. What kind of NoSQL should we use? Ideally, we want to choose a NoSQL that has the following properties:

另一个可考虑的方案是 NoSQL 数据库。如果你不熟悉 Redis，这会是面试中可以谈的好选择。该用哪种 NoSQL？理想情况下，我们希望选一个具备以下特性的 NoSQL：

  • Optimized for writes.

    写优化。

  • Efficiently sort items within the same partition by score.

    能高效地按分数在同一分区内排序条目。

NoSQL databases such as Amazon’s DynamoDB [16], Cassandra, or MongoDB can be a good fit. In this chapter, we use DynamoDB as an example. DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database that offers reliable performance and great scalability. To allow efficient access to data with attributes other than the primary key, we can leverage global secondary indexes [17] in DynamoDB. A global secondary index contains a selection of attributes from the parent table, but they are organized using a different primary key. Let’s take a look at an example.

Amazon DynamoDB [16]、Cassandra 或 MongoDB 等 NoSQL 数据库可能很合适。本章以 DynamoDB 为例。DynamoDB 是全托管 NoSQL 数据库，提供可靠性能和出色可扩展性。为了能高效访问主键以外属性的数据，我们可以利用 DynamoDB 的全局二级索引 [17]。全局二级索引包含父表的一部分属性，但用不同主键组织。看个例子。

The updated system diagram is shown in Figure 21. Redis and MySQL are replaced with DynamoDB.

更新后的系统图如图 21。Redis 和 MySQL 被替换为 DynamoDB。

Assume we design the leaderboard for a chess game and our initial table is shown in Figure 22. It is a denormalized view of the leaderboard and user tables and contains everything needed to render a leaderboard.

假设我们为一款象棋游戏设计排行榜，初始表如图 22。它是排行榜表和用户表的反规范化视图，包含渲染排行榜所需的一切。

This table scheme works, but it doesn’t scale well. As more rows are added, we have to scan the entire table to find the top scores.

这种表方案可行，但扩展性不好。随着行数增加，我们必须扫描整张表才能找到最高分。

To avoid a linear scan, we need to add indexes. Our first attempt is to use “game_name#{year-month}” as the partition key and the score as the sort key, as shown in Figure 23.

为避免线性扫描，我们需要加索引。第一次尝试是用 “game_name#{year-month}” 作为分区键、score 作为排序键，如图 23。

This works, but it runs into issues at a high load. DynamoDB splits data across multiple nodes using consistent hashing. Each item lives in a corresponding node based on its partition key. We want to structure the data so that data is evenly distributed across partitions. In our table design (Figure 23), all the data for the most recent month would be stored in one partition and that partition becomes a hot partition. How can we solve this problem?

这可行，但在高负载下会出问题。DynamoDB 使用一致性哈希把数据切分到多个节点。每个条目根据其分区键位于对应节点。我们希望组织数据，使数据在各分区间均匀分布。在我们的表设计（图 23）中，最近一个月的所有数据会存在一个分区，该分区成为热点分区。如何解决？

We can split data into N partitions and append a partition number (user_id % number_of_partitions) to the partition key. This pattern is called write sharding. Write sharding adds complexity for both read and write operations, so we should consider the trade-offs carefully.

我们可以把数据拆成 N 个分区，并在分区键后追加一个分区号（user_id % number_of_partitions）。这种模式称为写分片（write sharding）。写分片会增加读写操作的复杂度，因此要仔细权衡。

The second question we need to answer is, how many partitions should we have? It can be based on write volume or DAU. The important thing to remember is that there is a trade-off between load on partitions and read complexity. Because data for the same month is spread evenly across multiple partitions, the load for a single partition is much lighter. However, to read items for a given month, we have to query all the partitions and merge the results, which adds read complexity.

第二个要回答的问题是：应该有多少个分区？可以基于写量或 DAU。要记住的重要一点是：分区负载与读复杂度之间存在取舍。由于同一个月的数据均匀分散在多个分区，单个分区负载轻得多；但要读取某个月的条目，就必须查询所有分区并合并结果，这增加了读复杂度。

The partition key looks something like this: “game_name#{year-month}#p{partition_number}”. Figure 24 shows the updated schema table.

分区键大致形如：“game_name#{year-month}#p{partition_number}”。更新后的表结构如图 24。

The global secondary index uses “game_name#{year-month}#p{partition_number}” as the partition key and the score as the sort key. What we end up with are N partitions that are all sorted within their own partition (locally sorted). If we assume we had 3 partitions, then in order to fetch the top 10 leaderboard, we would use the approach called “scatter-gather” mentioned earlier. We would fetch the top 10 results in each of the partitions (this is the “scatter” portion), and then we would allow the application to sort the results among all the partitions (this is the “gather” portion). An example is shown in Figure 25.

全局二级索引以 “game_name#{year-month}#p{partition_number}” 为分区键、score 为排序键。最终得到 N 个分区，每个分区内部各自排序（局部有序）。假设我们有 3 个分区，要取前 10 排行榜，就用前面提到的“分散-聚集”方式：先在每个分区中取前 10（这是“分散”部分），再让应用在所有分区间对结果排序（这是“聚集”部分）。例子见图 25。

You might be wondering how to decide on the number of partitions. This might require some careful benchmarking. More partitions decrease the load on each partition but add complexity, as you need to scatter across more partitions to build your final leaderboard. By employing benchmarking, we can see the trade-off more clearly and so decide upon the number.

你可能想知道分区数该如何定。这可能需要仔细基准测试。分区越多，每个分区负载越轻，但复杂度增加，因为你要分散到更多分区才能拼出最终排行榜。通过基准测试，我们能更清楚地看到取舍，从而决定数量。

However, similar to the Redis partition solution mentioned earlier, this approach doesn’t provide a straightforward solution for determining the relative rank of a user. But it is possible to get the percentile of a user’s position, which could be good enough. In real life, telling a player that they are in the top 10-20% might be better than showing the exact rank at eg.1,200,001. Therefore, if the scale is large enough that we needed to shard, we could assume that the score distributions are roughly the same across all shards. If this assumption is true, we could have a cron job that analyzes the distribution of the score for each shard, and caches that result.

然而，与前面提到的 Redis 分区方案类似，这种方案也无法直接确定用户的相对排名。但可以得到用户位置的百分位，这或许就够了。现实中，告诉玩家“你在前 10–20%”可能比显示确切名次（如 1,200,001 名）更好。因此，如果规模大到需要分片，我们可以假设各分片的分数分布大致相同。若该假设成立，可以用一个定时任务分析每个分片的分数分布，并缓存结果。

The result would look something like this:

结果大致如下：

10th percentile = score < 100

第 10 百分位 = 分数 < 100

20th percentile = score < 500

第 20 百分位 = 分数 < 500

...

……

90th percentile = score < 6500

第 90 百分位 = 分数 < 6500

Then we could quickly return a user's relative ranking (say 90th percentile).

然后我们就能快速返回用户的相对排名（比如第 90 百分位）。

§Step 4 - Wrap Up第四步——总结

In this chapter, we have created a solution for building a real-time game leaderboard with the scale of millions of DAU. We explored the straightforward solution of using a MySQL database and rejected that approach because it does not scale for millions of users. We then designed the leaderboard using Redis sorted sets. We also looked into scaling the solution to 500 million DAU, by leveraging sharding across different Redis caches. We also proposed an alternative NoSQL solution.

在本章中，我们构建了一个支持数百万 DAU 规模的实时游戏排行榜方案。我们先探讨了使用 MySQL 数据库的直接方案，因它无法扩展到数百万用户而放弃。随后用 Redis 有序集合设计了排行榜。我们还研究了通过在不同 Redis 缓存间分片，把方案扩展到 5 亿 DAU，并提出了一个 NoSQL 替代方案。

In the event you have some extra time at the end of your interview, you can cover a few more topics:

如果面试最后还有时间，可以再覆盖几个话题：

Faster retrieval and breaking tie

更快检索与打破平局

A Redis Hash provides a map between string fields and values. We could leverage a hash for 2 use cases:

Redis Hash 提供字符串字段到值的映射。我们可以把它用于 2 个用例：

  1. To store a map of the user id to the user object that we can display on the leaderboard. This allows for faster retrieval than having to go to the database to fetch the user object.

    存 user id 到用户对象的映射，用于在排行榜上展示。这比每次都到数据库取用户对象更快。

  2. In the case of two players having the same scores, we could rank the users based on who received that score first. When we increment the score of the user, we can also store a map of the user id to the timestamp of the most recently won game. In the case of a tie, the user with the older timestamp ranks higher.

    当两个玩家分数相同时，我们可以按谁先拿到该分数来排名。给用户加分时，同时存 user id 到最近一次获胜时间戳的映射。平分时，时间戳更早的用户排名更高。

System failure recovery

系统故障恢复

The Redis cluster can potentially experience a large-scale failure. Given the design above, we could create a script that leverages the fact that the MySQL database records an entry with a timestamp each time a user won a game. We could iterate through all of the entries for each user, and call ZINCRBY once per entry, per user. This would allow us to recreate the leaderboard offline if necessary, in case of a large-scale outage.

Redis 集群可能遭遇大规模故障。基于上述设计，我们可以写一个脚本，利用“MySQL 数据库在用户每次赢一局时都记录一条带时间戳的条目”这一事实。我们可以遍历每个用户的所有条目，对每个用户的每条条目调用一次 ZINCRBY。这样在大规模宕机时，必要时我们可以离线重建排行榜。

恭喜你坚持到这里！给自己一点鼓励吧，干得漂亮！
